theme_central: From the terror of the Hour to the story of the pilgrimage established by Ibrahim, then permission to defend oneself — worship and legitimate fighting in the service of one single cause.
sources_note: Division into 10 rukus precisely sourced (alim.org), regrouped here into 7 branches for the clarity of the map.

branches.title: Terror of the Hour
branches.resume: The earthquake of the Hour will make every nursing mother forget her infant.

children.t: The earthquake of the Hour, the argument from man's progressive creation

branches.title: Hypocritical faith, divine power
branches.resume: Criticism of those who worship Allah on a knife's edge; divine power over creation and resurrection.

children.t: Criticism of hypocritical faith, conditional on success
Divine power over creation and resurrection

branches.title: Ibrahim and the Kaaba, rites of pilgrimage
branches.resume: Ibrahim establishes monotheistic worship at the Kaaba, rites of sacrifice and pilgrimage.

children.t: Ibrahim establishes monotheistic worship at the Kaaba, call to pilgrimage
Rites of sacrifice, humility of hearts during pilgrimage

branches.title: Permission to fight in defense
branches.resume: First Qur'anic permission to fight, to protect mosques, synagogues and churches.

children.t: Permission to fight in defense, protection of places of worship

branches.title: Judgment, patience, signs
branches.resume: Monotheism reaffirmed, patience of tested believers, cosmic signs of Allah's power.

children.t: Patience of tested believers, cosmic signs

branches.title: Refutation of the idolaters
branches.resume: Their idols cannot even create a fly.

children.t: Refutation of the idolaters, their idols unable to create a fly

branches.title: Closing
branches.resume: Call to humility, prayer, and striving (jihad) in the path of Allah.

children.t: Humility, prayer, striving in the way of Allah, religion made without hardship
